tasks.task_description: Add animation tokens to theme system (durations, easings, delays)
Create CSS animation classes with reduced-motion support
Enhance toast animations with enter/exit transitions
Add loading state animations to buttons and forms
Style empty states with subtle animations
Add hover/focus microinteractions to interactive elements

description: T213 Motion & microinteractions: subtle transitions, toasts, loading states, skeletons, and empty states themed; reduced-motion support. Outcome: animation tokens + classes.
context: Added comprehensive animation tokens to theme.css including durations (xs to xl), easings (standard, emphasized, bounce, elastic), delays, and scale/translate values. Created animations.css with CSS animation classes, keyframes, and reduced-motion support.

Enhanced toast animations with Radix Toast integration, added loading state animations to Button component with improved spinner, implemented Skeleton component with shimmer animations, created EmptyState component with staggered fade-in animations, enhanced Input component with focus transitions, and created basic animation tests.
